title: Solomon's Divided Heart
reflectionText: It was not a sudden fall. Solomon let the women he loved turn his heart a little at a time, until it was no longer wholly Yahweh's. God had appeared to him twice, and still his heart drifted. The kingdom would be torn — though not all of it, and not in his lifetime, for the sake of his father David. How does a heart get divided so slowly that no one notices?
